#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

static int weight;
static int itemMass;
static vector<bool> arr(100, false);

bool isBalanced() {
    long pod1 = itemMass, pod2 = 0;
    while (true) {
        if (pod1 > pod2) {
            long nextMass = getMass(pod1 - pod2);
            if (nextMass != 0)
                pod2 += nextMass;
            else
                break;
        } else if (pod1 < pod2) {
            long nextMass1 = getMass(pod2 - pod1);
            if (nextMass1 != 0)
                pod1 += nextMass1;
            else
                break;
        } else {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

long getMass(long mass) {
    int logBase = (int)(log(mass) / log(weight));
    long sumTotal;
    // Compute (weight^(logBase+1) - 1) / (weight - 1) using pow
    long long numerator = (long long)pow(weight, logBase + 1) - 1;
    long long denominator = weight - 1;
    sumTotal = numerator / denominator;

    if (mass > sumTotal && !arr[logBase + 1]) {
        long result = (long)pow(weight, logBase + 1);
        arr[logBase + 1] = true;
        return result;
    } else if (mass <= sumTotal && !arr[logBase]) {
        long result = (long)pow(weight, logBase);
        arr[logBase] = true;
        return result;
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}

int main() {
    cin >> weight >> itemMass;
    if (isBalanced())
        cout << "YES" << endl;
    else
        cout << "NO" << endl;
    return 0;
}
